# pve_notification_endpoint_smtp (Resource)

SMTP notification endpoint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_notification_endpoint_smtp" "example" {
  from_address = "CHANGE_ME"
  name         = "CHANGE_ME"
  server       = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `from_address` (String) `From` address for the mail
- `name` (String) The name of the endpoint.
- `server` (String) The address of the SMTP server.

### Optional

- `author` (String) Author of the mail. Defaults to 'Proxmox VE'.
- `comment` (String) Comment
- `delete` (List of String) A list of settings you want to delete.
- `disable` (Boolean) Disable this target (default: 0)
- `mailto` (List of String) List of email recipients
- `mailto_user` (List of String) List of users
- `mode` (String) Determine which encryption method shall be used for the connection. (default: tls) One of: `insecure`, `starttls`, `tls`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for SMTP authentication
- `port` (Number) The port to be used. Defaults to 465 for TLS based connections, 587 for STARTTLS based connections and port 25 for insecure plain-text connections.
- `username` (String) Username for SMTP authentication

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: name (also the `terraform import` format).
